source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-2

procedures.title: Heater controls: Corvette description
notes: 1968 Corvette controls are a new thumb-wheel type mounted in the floor console (see figure 3 in the manual); duct door layout and airflow match the other car lines (figure 1).
Fan lever (front of the panel): full left is off; moving it right selects the three blower speeds LOW, MED, HIGH.
Do not switch the blower on unless the AIR door is at least half open.
TEMPERATURE thumb-wheel (right side) moves the temperature door by bowden cable, changing the mix of heated and unheated air from cold to hot.

AIR/DE-ICE thumb-wheel (left side, bowden cable): at the 'air' detent the AIR door opens; moving past 'air' begins opening the DEFROSTER door for partial defrost flow; at 'de-ice' nearly all air goes to the defroster ducts. Positions between 'air' and 'de-ice' vary the floor/defroster split.
